fact: Sudan Events reports the Customs Authority launched an electronic container tracking system at Southern Port Customs, developed with Zain Telecom, the customs General Directorate of ICT and the Customs Risk Division.

Sudan Customs' information technology directorate says its own software officers programmed the electronic customs valuation database and the e-violations system, which were run on Oracle APEX and 19c.
The acting director general of Sudan Customs launched the electronic customs valuation database at the North Port, built by customs IT officers rather than a contractor.
